verdict.rationale: Inngest is purpose-built for background automation that runs autonomously: durable execution with step-level retries/checkpointing, scheduled/cron and event-triggered functions, wait-for-event, retries, and full observability without manual worker/queue management, corroborated by multiple hands-on community reports of running production background jobs reliably. It also explicitly extends this to autonomous AI agents (durable agent loops, checkpointing tool calls) rather than just generic jobs. missing for 10: independent benchmark of long-running unattended reliability beyond anecdotal community reports.
